messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action so that they raise both hands in celebration, then thrust one hand upward, matching the motion demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action so that they raise both hands in celebration, then thrust one hand upward, as shown in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands still, then raises both arms overhead and shifts her weight in a brief dance-like pose before lowering her arms and returning to a standing position.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot that keeps the subject centered in the frame throughout the clip.","clothing":"A short black dress with off-the-shoulder puffed sleeves, a white lace-up front panel, and a white side panel, paired with light blue sneakers.","hair_color":"Bright blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair pulled up into a high bun with a few loose strands framing the face.","identity":"A slim young woman with a fair complexion and a small face, shown in full body from head to toe.","scene":"An empty paved road or plaza beside a concrete overpass, with orange-and-white construction barriers, a blue directional sign, a metal guardrail, and green trees in the background under bright daylight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman now raises both arms overhead in a celebratory pose around the middle of the clip, then lowers them and returns to standing. The original scene, clothing, hairstyle, lighting, and static low-angle framing remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action so they raise both hands in celebration, then thrust one hand upward, while preserving identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the later one-hand upward thrust from the reference motion is clearly present; the visible output mainly shows both arms raised together.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly cropped or reframed compared with the source, with black bars visible at the top and bottom in some frames.
